notes: Designer spec action economy: each turn has 1 minor and 1 major action. First pass implements Move, Aim, Attack and End Turn.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): movement can be split. The first Move spends the minor action; any tiles left can be walked later the same turn at no extra action. Aim as the minor action means no movement that turn.
Designer decision (Oct 2026), following the book (STA 2e Quickstart p. 22): there is no Take Cover action. A unit next to a cover object is in cover automatically (removed from the mockup's panel).
panel: the actions shown in the Actions panel, in mockup order. The others are defined for later passes.

actions.name: Move
actions.description: End next to a cover object to be in cover.

actions.name: Aim
actions.description: Reroll one attack die this turn.
